notes: Web search ran out for the session partway through this part (the tool reported 200 of 200 used) after one search each for 29 of the 30 candidates and a few follow-ups; the rest was done by reading known pages directly with the kit's User-Agent, robots.txt obeyed. Nothing usable was found, or could be searched further, for Jen Fracisco, Donald Jorgenson (not on the City of Vadnais Heights council page), Jason Jensen (the district's elections page lists his affidavit only), Eliza Robertson, Jennifer Anderson (listed only as a 2026 candidate on the district's page), Jacob Bases, Michael Baskins, Danny O. Lundell and Stuart Dukek. A missing website here is not proof that none exists.

Out of reach and not worked around: mncourts.gov answers 403 (no official page for either judge); cfb.mn.gov and www.clearwatercountymn.gov are closed to scripts by robots.txt (Clearwater County's officers page does list 'District 3 - Stuart Dukek', seen once through WebFetch before the robots.txt was read, and is not cited); www.mankatomn.gov is closed by robots.txt. The Forum Communications papers (Duluth News Tribune, Post Bulletin, St. Cloud Live) were not opened or cited.

Campaign websites seen but not confirmed, so left out: Wikipedia's article on Nick Frentz links https://www.frentzformnsenate.com/ (timed out three times); peggyscott.org reset the connection and may not be hers. Wayne Grimmer's site answered the kit's fetch but not WebFetch (a name lookup failure), so a verifier may need a second try.

Tanja Goering: KNSI Radio reported on March 17, 2026 that Republican delegates in House District 13A endorsed her (https://knsiradio.com/?p=817327). That is a news report, not the party's own page, so there is no endorsed_by entry. The DFL's June 5, 2026 release on its endorsed slate (dfl.org/icymi-dfl-endorsed-slate-of-candidates) names no legislative candidates, so nothing is recorded for Nick Frentz or Rick Olson.

Rick Olson: Wikipedia's article 'Rick Olson (Michigan politician)' gives a birth date and says he retired to Prior Lake, Minnesota, but the date carries no citation there, so no birth year is recorded. The Prior Lake News Compass article ties the Michigan service to this candidate (Prior Lake resident, DFL candidate for Senate District 54).

Frank Pafko: the election archive is neither Wikipedia nor a news organization; it is labelled secondary and the date is cut to the year, as part 5 did. The same person by Richfield residence, party and state legislative runs. His 2020 primary win in 63B is on the same page and not listed separately.

Nathan Burr: the district's school board page builds its text by script, so the kit's fetch saw no names; the listing (board member, chair, term ending 12/31/2026) was seen only in a web search result of that page. A verifier who cannot see it should remove it.

Tasha Connelly: the City's page about her still shows a term of January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2024. Patrick Keane: our record calls the seat 'Council Member, District 1'; the City and the news call it Ward 1. Neither is recorded as a review item.
Angela Conley's start is from MinnPost's report of the November 2018 election; Hennepin County's page gives no dates.
